snippet.title: MEDIX – Playtest Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Join playtest now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405140/MEDIX/

A minimalistic real-time strategy where you command a unit of war medics struggling to save lives as their army retreats under the pressure of an overwhelming foe.

Join MEDIX Discord: https://discord.gg/vYKzDqXUeG

How much can a person endure, and what is the true value of human life? In this minimalist real-time strategy game about war medics, you fight for your own survival and that of others while the army is under constant pressure, retreating from a superior enemy. A narrative campaign, accompanied by hand-drawn illustrations, takes you through the story of physicians pushed to their breaking point in their fight for a sliver of hope.

MEDIX is a solo-developed indie game by Buldozer Production.
